meta.note: The owner's corrections to the exported model, keyed by Revit element id, each with a reason. Applied by scripts/rasterise.py when it builds the tiles; exports/ itself is never changed. An edit whose position is inferred says so. Kinds: add_door (a door the model lacks, in host wall), add_opening (a doorway without a leaf, in host wall), add_wall (a wall the model lacks: between rooms, painted on wall_on's side of their shared boundary; or against: outside on a side of the room, where the room is open to the outside), note (a confirmation or a question about elements, no change). A door entry with leaf: false is a doorway without a panel.
